about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Aqua Engineers, Inc. (Schofield Barracks plant, Wahiawa)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62-06(g) and Appendix B (Responses for Wastewater Spills, Overflows, and Discharges, July 1, 2014), sections 2.b and 9.a: for a spill into state waters the owner or its agent shall "immediately notify the CWB" and submit a written report within five working days; permit HI0110141: HAR 11-55 (water pollution control), the NPDES permits' standard conditions: noncompliance that may endanger health or the environment is reported to the Department of Health
channels.note: Aqua Engineers, Inc. (Schofield Barracks plant, Wahiawa) reports a spill into state waters to the Department of Health's Clean Water Branch immediately and in writing within five working days. The report itself is not published; the Department's advisory for the affected waters is, in the list the feed reads (a notice names the facility when the Department gives it). (HAR 11-62 Appendix B, read 2026-11-07)

channels.name: Aqua Engineers, Inc. (Schofield Barracks plant, Wahiawa)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62 Appendix B, sections 2.c, 4.c and 7: for a spill into state waters, and for one onto the ground where the public has access, the owner or its agent "shall immediately send out a press release for spills of a thousand gallons or more and for lesser spills if they present a substantial threat to public health", to the Associated Press, major newspapers and television news stations, the Department's Communications Office and the Clean Water Branch (the Wastewater Branch for a ground spill)
channels.note: No URL known (not searched): the rule sends the operator's press release to the news media and the Department, not to a web page; whether this operator posts its releases on its own site was not searched.

channels.name: Aqua Engineers, Inc. (Schofield Barracks plant, Wahiawa)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62 Appendix B, sections 2.e and 4.e: the owner or its agent "shall immediately post warning signs in the area(s) likely to be affected by the spill and where public access is possible" (a spill into state waters), and "in the vicinity of the spill area" (a spill onto the ground where the public has access); the Department assures that enough signs are posted and authorizes their removal
channels.note: No web form: warning signs at the affected waters, posted by the operator. On site only.

channels.agency: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (water quality advisories and events)
channels.authority: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.note: The Department's portal lists every advisory it issues (sewage spills, permit exceedances, Brown Water Advisories, beach advisories and retest notifications), open and closed, from one JSON endpoint: the newest 500 of 1,901 events on 2026-11-07 (Brown Water Advisory 279, Beach Notification 104, Beach Advisory 52, Sewage Spill 50, Permit Exceedance 15). Read every refresh by the feed. No terms or licence stated. The Department's practice; no rule requiring it was found. (research/hi/sources.json)

channels.agency: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (e-mail notices by island)
channels.note: E-mail notices of the same advisories, by island, through the portal's subscription form; the advisories themselves are read from the portal's list. Not subscribed.

channels.agency: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (warning signs at the water)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62 Appendix B, sections 2.e and 4.e: the owner or its agent "shall immediately post warning signs in the area(s) likely to be affected by the spill and where public access is possible" (a spill into state waters), and "in the vicinity of the spill area" (a spill onto the ground where the public has access); the Department assures that enough signs are posted and authorizes their removal
channels.note: No web form: the operator posts warning signs at the affected waters; the Department checks that enough are posted and authorizes their removal, and its portal gives the removal time ("Warning signs have been posted" in its sewage spill notices). On site only.

channels.agency: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (wastewater spill reports)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62-06(g) and Appendix B (Responses for Wastewater Spills, Overflows, and Discharges, July 1, 2014), sections 2.b and 9.a: for a spill into state waters the owner or its agent shall "immediately notify the CWB" and submit a written report within five working days; HAR 11-55 (water pollution control), the NPDES permits' standard conditions: noncompliance that may endanger health or the environment is reported to the Department of Health
channels.note: No web form: every wastewater operator, public or private, reports a spill into state waters to the Clean Water Branch immediately and in writing within five working days (HAR 11-62 Appendix B, read in the Department's copy https://health.hawaii.gov/opppd/files/2026/08/chapter-11-62-HAR-effective-2016.03.21.pdf on 2026-11-07). The reports themselves are not published; the Department posts an advisory for the waters it judges affected (hi-doh-cwb-advisories). The operator's own duties to the public are its press release and its warning signs (the operator rows).

channels.name: Hawaii State Department of Health (news releases)
channels.note: The Department's news releases; large spills also get a release. Answered 200 on 2026-11-07. Page health only: the advisories are read from the portal's list. Voluntary. (research/hi/sources.json hi-doh-news-releases)

channels.agency: Hawaii Department of Health, Wastewater Branch
channels.name: Hawaii Department of Health, Wastewater Branch (ground spill reports)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62 Appendix B, section 4 (spills onto the ground, not into state waters, where the public has or may have access): for a spill of a thousand gallons or more the owner or its agent immediately notifies the Wastewater Branch on Oahu, or the district environmental health program chief on the other islands, and reports in writing under section 9.a; smaller spills go in a quarterly tabulated summary (section 9.b)
channels.note: No web form: spills that reach no state water, where the public has access, are reported to the Wastewater Branch (or a district office) and, under 1,000 gallons, only in quarterly summaries. Neither is published, and such spills get no Clean Water Branch advisory; the operator's press release and signs (sections 4.c and 4.e) are the public notice. (HAR 11-62 Appendix B, read 2026-11-07)
